crossRefs.note: He sent him away to his house, saying, “Don’t enter into the village, nor tell anyone in the village.”
He commanded them that they should tell no one, but the more he commanded them, so much the more widely they proclaimed…
As they were coming down from the mountain, he commanded them that they should tell no one what things they had seen…
Then he commanded the disciples that they should tell no one that he was Jesus the Christ.
But he warned them, and commanded them to tell this to no one,

parallels.note: But he warned them, and commanded them to tell this to no one,

translations.web: He commanded them that they should tell no one about him.
translations.bsb: And Jesus warned them not to tell anyone about Him.
translations.kjv: And he charged them that they should tell no man of him.
translations.asv: And he charged them that they should tell no man of him.
